title: MiniGames
wikitext: '''MiniGames''' is a multiplayer addon for quick and fun mini-games. Use the interface to challenge friends and enjoy casual competitions directly in-game. '''Manual Installation Only''' # Download this zip: '''[https://web.archive.org/web/20061215132136/http://d.cosmosui.org/files/distros/Cosmos_Release.zip Cosmos_Release.zip]''' # Unpack the .zip and move these folders from Interface/AddOns into your Interface/AddOns directory and restart the game. * Chronos * Earth * Khaos * Sea * Telepathy * Telepathy-Versions * MobileFrames * EarthFeatureFrame == Interface == '''Main Menu:''' * Opens via keybinding or clicking the EarthFeature mini-map button. * Features options to select different games, view current matches, and configure options. '''Game Windows:''' * Each game (e.g., Chess, Minesweeper) has its own interface with interactive buttons, move indicators, and quit/restart options. '''Chat Integration:''' * The addon communicates game states via whispers and channel messages, formatted with a specific prefix for recognition. == Preview == [[File:Minigames.png|border|frameless|465x465px]] == Additional Notes == '''Custom Icons:''' * The addon can use default WoW icons or custom icons for pieces (configurable in options). '''Game Settings:''' * Options menu allows enabling/disabling custom icons, adjusting game difficulty, and more. '''Multiplayer:''' * Games are played via whisper or channel messages. Ensure your friends are also running the addon. '''Troubleshooting''' * Restart the game window if issues occur. * Use the '''"Quit"''' button to leave a game early. * Use '''"Restart"''' to reset the current game. [[Category:Addon]]
